nodes.description: u32_to_u8 converts the punycode payload after 'xn--' to UTF-8. When the label is exactly 'xn--' (zero codepoints after prefix), ace_len equals payload_codepoint_count: both are 0, producing a heap buffer with no initialized bytes.

edges.description: ace_len from the u32_to_u8 result at the call site propagates as the input_length parameter to _idn2_punycode_decode. When ace_len == 0, input_length == 0 at the callee.

root_cause_criterion.obligation: input_length > 0 must be checked before b += delim(input[b])
root_cause_criterion.description: The statement b += delim(input[b]) unconditionally reads input[0] regardless of input_length. When input_length == 0, input[0] is beyond the valid buffer, reading uninitialized heap memory. The fix adds 'if (input_length)' before this statement.
